title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF-Burundi supported 255,352 children (51% girls) in accessing education, including 83,061 in humanitarian situations. Learning materials reached 218,952 children, and 13,485 re-enrolled. Support was provided to children affected by climate emergencies and Mpox, ensuring continuity in learning and promoting inclusive education, attendance, and retention.
